about: What Mars's wind does to its dust round the camp, as the game 2099 draws it (MarsWind, DustDevil, #116): on the calm afternoon the scene record holds, the drift's fine grains blowing along the ground on the five by five cells round the camp's middle and two dust devils wandering the plain in sight of the outside cameras; in a dust storm (the variant `storm`) the drift thick, fast and head high and no devils. The drift moves here, so the scene record's still drift (Sky/Dust) is made inactive in this layer. Real footage checked: the Spirit rover's Gusev crater films of dust devils (NASA/JPL, 2005: slim see-through columns, narrow at the foot, widening as they climb) and the Apollo 16 film for fine dust reading as a veil (2099's #116, the owner's rule that many fine grains read and big sparse ones do not).

wind.from: game/outside/dust/mars_wind.gd:53-54,117-125 (WIND_TURN_A_DAY 0.9 radians a base day, wind_along: the ground's up crossed with x, turned by the minute), at the base minute the scene record's sun was worked out for (data/scene/camp.json lights: minute 8,630)

replaces.why: the scene record's drift hangs one still moment's worth of the same fine grains (data/scene/camp.json environment dust); the effects layer blows them along, so the still copy is made inactive here rather than drawn twice

effects.name: drift
effects.from: game/outside/dust/mars_wind.gd:18-52,190-219,280-313 (CELL_M 14, CELLS_OUT 2, DRIFT_HIGH_CALM 0.4, WIND_CALM 2.5 m/s at 0.7 to 1.2 of it, DRIFT_SECONDS 3, DRIFT_SINK 0.25, DRIFT_GRAINS_A_CELL 20,000 at DRIFT_GRAINS_CALM_SHARE 0.06 = 1,200 a cell, DRIFT_GRAIN_M 0.03, DRIFT_GRAIN_THICKNESS 0.7, spread 8, fading_in_and_out 0 / 0.2 / 0.7 / 1), game/outside/dust/dust_grains.gd:24-38,106-117 (the unshaded speck, MARS_DUST #b4583a lifted by GRAIN_LIFT 1.25 to #e16e48); the cells are the stage's own five by five round the camp's middle, not Mars's cell grid round the player

effects.name: devil_west
effects.from: game/outside/dust/dust_devil.gd:9-24,36-50,58-89 (TALL 20 over CLIMB 3 to 5 m/s: a 5 s life, FOOT_RADIUS 0.6 and half inside, ring 0.2 high, spread 6, WIDENING 0.35 at 0.5 to 1 of it, TURN 3 rad/s, GRAINS 6,000 of GRAIN_M 0.03 at GRAIN_THICKNESS 0.55, local coordinates), game/outside/dust/mars_wind.gd:56-61,225-247 (DEVIL_SECONDS 80, DEVIL_WANDER 1.4 m/s downwind, DEVIL_FADE 10: written 20 s into its life, at its thickest); the game sets each devil's spot from the world seed and the clock anywhere on Mars and draws those within 120 m of the player, so the stage stands this one 21 m from the camp's middle, 38 m out from the outside_front camera and 25 degrees off its aim, clear of the domes

effects.name: devil_west_veil
effects.from: game/outside/dust/dust_devil.gd:20-24,36-38 (VEIL_CARDS 300 of VEIL_CARD_M 1.2 at VEIL_THICKNESS 0.1 times 3, the same column as its grains), game/outside/dust/dust_grains.gd:81-88 and game/art/shaders/dust.gdshader:19-24,59-70 (the lit puff: thickest in its middle as (1 - r^2)^1.5, gone within 1 m of the eye and whole past 6 m)

effects.name: devil_east
effects.from: game/outside/dust/dust_devil.gd:9-24,36-50,58-89 and game/outside/dust/mars_wind.gd:56-61,225-247 (as devil_west, written 30 s into its life); stood 32 m from the camp's middle where the outside_far camera sees it clear of the domes, wandering downwind past them

effects.name: storm_grains
effects.from: game/outside/dust/mars_wind.gd:18-52,190-219,294-313 (in the thick of a storm: DRIFT_HIGH_STORM 4 m, WIND_STORM 11 m/s, all of DRIFT_GRAINS_A_CELL 20,000 a cell), dust_grains.gd:24-38; the stage lays the three by three cells round the camp's middle (42 m across) where the game lays five by five round the player: the game draws the drift only within DRIFT_DRAWN_M 22 m of the eye, faded over 10 m more
